verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out controls for GitLab; the pack covers API, CI/CD, security scanning, and unrelated community complaints. This is an applicable axis for a self-hosted/SaaS platform like GitLab, but absence of evidence means it cannot be credited. missing for 10: any documentation of telemetry settings, usage-ping opt-out, or privacy controls.
